approaches.name: Split, Reverse, and Weave
approaches.summary: Find the midpoint, reverse the second half, then alternate nodes from the two halves.
thinkingSteps: Use slow and fast pointers to locate the middle, then split the list.
Reverse links in the second half.
Weave nodes from the first and reversed second halves without losing next pointers.

bullets: The output alternates front and back nodes.
Reversing the back half makes its nodes available in the needed order.
